properties.description: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/the_tool_surface_tells_the_truth.rs drives a served session and the real binary: --args @file through --call, read and write, and its refusals; every revising constructor's find_tools line begins "Create or revise"; update_node/update/set_node are refused with the revise route (session and door); a query naming TemporalFact or Decision ranks record_finding or add_decision first, and add_temporal_fact/record_fact/add_fact are pointed at record_finding; the provenance and disposition enums are published and listed beside other problems; no prose value set escapes the guard; the ChangeEvent decoy is unadvertised and still redirected; an edge-only revise reports edges_changed beside changed:false. crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/the_mcp_surface_only_grows.rs compares the build with v0.79.0's tools, argument schemas and reply shapes and allows additions only. Each behaviour was measured failing on main 7f5984e's binary and passes on this branch.
properties.name: The tool surface tells the truth, and the MCP surface only grows
